Resolves #19433

The Portal's dist/development and dist/production tabs now open DevIndex's own entries:
- `examples_dist_dev.json` → `https://neomjs.com/devindex/dist/development/apps/devindex/`
- `examples_dist_prod.json` → `https://neomjs.com/devindex/dist/production/apps/devindex/`

Both entries went live with neomjs/devindex#62. The dev-mode and dist/esm rows stay on the site root until neomjs/devindex#61 serves those environments, which needs DevIndex on 13.2. Registries reach the live Portal only inside a release package, so this ships with 13.2 if it merges before the cut.

Evidence: L3 (both target URLs read live in headless Chromium before this PR) plus L2 (the registry spec, red on `dev` for each changed row) → L3 required for AC-3. Residual: none.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | The diff: two `url` values; `examples_devmode.json` and `examples_dist_esm.json` are unchanged |
| AC-2 | `TabContainerController.spec.mjs` pins each registry's DevIndex URL. Reverting either registry alone fails the arm at that file (`examples_dist_dev.json: DevIndex entry`, `examples_dist_prod.json: DevIndex entry`); with both changes, 5 of 5 pass |
| AC-3 | Live read at 16:46Z on DevIndex `55ce8d05` (neomjs/devindex#61, comment 6021047925). Both entries paint 14 grid rows and the learn view. Their index request goes to `https://neomjs.com/devindex/apps/devindex/resources/data/users.jsonl` (200), with no failed request |

## Deltas from ticket
None.

- Registry consumers: `apps/portal/view/examples/TabContainer.mjs` and the spec, by `git grep`.
